get.description: Retrieves all custom applications. If id query parameter is provided, returns only that specific application in the array.

items.description: Only HOST-based custom applications are supported via the Public API. URL-based custom applications are not supported at this time. get.description:
List all the reports based on provided details.

**reportType**:
- APPLICATION - For Application Reports
- WORKPLACE - For Workplace Reports
- DATA_EXPLORER - For Data Explorer Reports

**subType** helps to filter only certain types of reports. Default it's optional and pointing to "CustomDataFeed".
- CustomDataFeed - For custom Apps list and download
- ScheduledReports - For scheduled reports list and download
- SaveAndSchedule - For data explorer save and schedule reports list and download

parameters.description: Report start time as Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). If not provided or 0, defaults to midnight UTC of the 1st day of previous month.
parameters.name: startTime

parameters.description: Report end time as Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). If not provided or 0, defaults to the current time.
parameters.name: endTime

Invalid report subtype INVALID should be one of ScheduledReports/CustomDataFeed/SaveAndSchedule

get.description: Get Report Configurations along with their associated Custom Apps. Currently only report_type "customapps" is supported.

parameters.description: Type of report. Currently only "customapps" is supported.
parameters.name: report_type

parameters.description: Optional report configuration ID to retrieve.

items.description: Notes/Constraints: - schedule_params and backfill_params cannot both be provided with active values. - Either schedule_params or backfill_params must be provided. - Default limit: 50 active (scheduled) reports per organization. - The active report limit can be increased on a per-customer basis via exception-based approval.

backfill_params.description: Notes: - Used for one-time historical reports. - stime cannot be more than 180 days in the past. - Time range between stime and etime cannot exceed 92 days.
backfill_params.title: BackfillParamsDTO
